title: incident-bot: on-call diagnostics ranking and runbook linking improvements
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: improve on-call diagnostic signal quality and make runbook suggestions more relevant during incidents. Operators reported noisy runbook linking and low precision in diagnostic suggestion ranking when multiple SLOs fire simultaneously. This PR introduces a weighted ranking model for diagnostics (prefer recent regressions, higher impact SLOs, and on-call team ownership) and improves runbook auto-linking by adding context-aware heuristics and fuzzy title matching.

What this PR does (summary):
- Add weighted scoring pipeline for diagnostics suggestions that combines SLO impact, recent error trend, and on-call team affinity.
- Extend runbook auto-linker with improved title/keyword matching, tag intersection, and an allowlist for high-confidence links.
- Surface confidence score and top-3 rationale in on-call messages to give actionable context.
- Add telemetry events and metrics for suggestion precision/recall, link acceptance rate, and latency.
- Backfill small migration: existing runbook metadata gets a 'link_score_boost' when tagged as primary for an SLO.

Checklist: 
- [x] Design and linear ticket (ENG-3421)
- [x] Unit tests for ranking and linker heuristics
- [x] Integration test with mock SLO toolkit inputs
- [x] Telemetry emitted to observability pipeline
- [x] Docs: on-call message format and score explanation

Notes: This is focused on suggestion quality (ranking + linking) and does not change remediation/autofix behaviors yet. The scoring defaults are conservative and can be tuned via runtime flags.

References: Linear ENG-3421, Support ticket SUP-523, related PRs: pr-18762, pr-218765 for earlier SLO toolkit helpers.

review_comments: Marcus Lee: Nice work — the scoring model looks solid. A couple of questions: how sensitive is the ranking to the recency weight? Can we make that tunable without redeploying?
Aisha Patel (author): Good question — made recency weight configurable via feature flag (deploy/feature_flags.yaml). Added unit tests covering edge cases for long-tailed recency distributions.
Elena Rodriguez: Can you add a small throttling safeguard to avoid spamming links on noisy SLO flaps?
Aisha Patel (author): Added a debounce window (default 2m) in oncall_formatter and documented it. Also added metrics for link emission rate.
Samir Gupta: Telemetry looks fine; please ensure sensitive runbook contents are not logged. Also add a retention note in metrics.yaml.
Aisha Patel (author): Updated metrics.yaml to redact runbook bodies and added retention settings.
